item.title: Chattooga Middle School Claims FCAA Basketball Championship
item.description: The Chattooga Middle School Indians are league champions. The Indians captured the Floyd County Middle School Athletic Association (FCAA) championship with a hard-fought 52-41 victory over Coosa on the Eagles’ home court. Chattooga finished the season with an impressive 13-1 record.
